capo.evidence: No clamp/capo visible on neck in any frame. Side view (t=0.0-6.0s, 15.0-17.0s) and front view (t=7.0-14.0s) both show bare fretboard, strings and wood at the nut and first several frets with no device attached behind any fret.

tuning.evidence: Only silent frames provided at 1fps with no audio to analyze pitch, and no close-up detail of tuning pegs/string tension interval to infer tuning visually. Standard classical tuning is likely but cannot be determined from images alone.

fretting_hand.note: Side/right-angle view from stage left. Left fretting hand on neck is visible throughout, fingers moving on mid-neck, but fret numbers not readable due to distance, angle and resolution.
Camera switches to frontal/center view. Left fretting hand remains visible on upper neck, playing and shifting position (approx. 2nd-7th fret region), but exact frets cannot be read clearly.
Camera returns to side/right-angle view to end of clip. Fretting hand still visible on neck and active, covers open to mid-neck area, exact lowest/highest frets not resolvable.
